item.title: 英伟达发现简单线性数学可取代高昂的 AI 模型交接
item.summary: When an agentic AI system hands a task from a small model to a larger one — or back down again — it pays a steep tax: the receiving model has to recompute the entire conversation from scratch, driving up compute costs and latency.
